episode_title: Claude's New Office Suite, Fable 5.2 and ChatGPT Business Listings

real_qa.q: What office suite features does Claude now include to compete with Google Workspace?
real_qa.r: Claude now includes Sheets with real formulas, Docs with comments and suggesting modes, Slides, Whiteboards, live dashboards you can share with clients, and a note taker that joins your meetings and builds plans while you're talking. All of these features are included inside the Claude subscription you already pay for, essentially offering a full Google Workspace replacement built directly into Claude.
real_qa.requete: Claude office suite features Google Workspace

real_qa.q: How do Claude Sheets formulas and functions work compared to Google Sheets?
real_qa.r: Claude Sheets functions exactly like Google Sheets or Excel with full formula support, pivot tables, and all the advanced features. You can ask Claude to create sheets, it will generate them with formulas already in place, and you can edit everything through prompts or by clicking on items. You don't need to learn formulas yourself—it handles everything within the cloud interface.
real_qa.requete: Claude Sheets formulas functions pivot tables

real_qa.q: What is Claude's new Fable 2.0 model and what does it cost?
real_qa.r: Claude has released Fable 2.0 as the new top model, representing a real step forward but it comes at a pretty significant cost. This advancement has led to changes in how and when you should use top models in your workflow.

real_qa.q: What are the individual Claude subscription pricing tiers and usage limits in 2024?
real_qa.r: Claude offers three individual pricing tiers: $20 per month with base usage, $100 per month giving five times more usage, and $200 per month providing ten times more usage. The $200 plan no longer has a five-hour limit and includes $200 of API credits. Each paid plan tier includes corresponding API credit allocation based on subscription level.

real_qa.q: How do Claude's Team and Enterprise plans differ from individual plans in token pricing?
real_qa.r: Team and Enterprise plans charge per seat plus API rates after usage allowance is consumed. Standard seats cost 18 euros with slightly more usage than the $20 plan, premium seats cost the equivalent of $100, but API rates beyond included usage are significantly higher—about 90 percent more expensive per token than subscription rates. Individual plans don't have this API overage structure; instead, they provide fixed monthly usage.
real_qa.requete: Claude Team Enterprise plan pricing API rates per seat

guest.bio_context: Gail Breton is co-founder of Authority Hacker, where he and Mark Webster test AI tools inside their business to help business owners understand what's worth paying for. He has hands-on experience with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI platforms, and leads the AI Accelerator program that teaches business owners how to use AI tools and provides access to a plugin marketplace.
